primary_review_findings: The branch makes fine venation, attachment and upper/lower surface differences substantially more readable than the earlier simple blades.
The fern frame orientation was corrected after native review; shared pinnae still show regularity.

The patch preserves curled litter instead of flattening leaves onto terrain. In the native 2K view, several dead leaves still look paper-like and stand too prominently above their support; that appearance is not approved for full-forest replication.
remaining_limits: No new whole-forest branching/placement rollout in this package.
Stems remain too uniformly cylindrical and material response is authored, not spectrally measured.
Leaf edges and decay states remain finite procedural variants.
Local support raster is not a collision-free cloth or global equilibrium solution. Decay detail and shape/contact/material balance still need a further visual pass.
The four-second film is a branch inspection, not rainforest wind animation.
No exact botanical specimen reconstruction or hyperrealism certification.
